issues.legal_issue: A borrower who deliberately omits relief available in an earlier suit to reopen loan decrees cannot seek that relief in a successive suit.
material_facts: The borrower first sued for relief concerning a personal decree arising from a mortgage loan and sought reopening of that decree only.
The borrower could have sought reopening of the preliminary and final mortgage decrees in the first suit but deliberately abandoned that relief.
The borrower later brought another suit concerning the same loan transaction to obtain reopening of the preliminary and final mortgage decrees.
issues.conclusion: The later suit was barred; the appeal was allowed and the suit was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Section 36 of the Bengal Money-lenders Act, 1940, contemplated one suit, not successive suits, for reopening transactions and decrees. The principles underlying section 11 and Order 2, rule 2 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, applied: relief available but not claimed or deliberately abandoned in the earlier suit could not be sought in a later suit.

rule.if: successive_borrower_relief_suit and prior_borrower_relief_suit and same_loan_transaction and omitted_relief_available_earlier and omitted_relief_deliberately_abandoned

predicates.successive_borrower_relief_suit: The current proceeding is a borrower's suit seeking relief to reopen a loan transaction or decree.
predicates.prior_borrower_relief_suit: The borrower previously brought a suit seeking relief concerning the same loan transaction or its decrees.
predicates.same_loan_transaction: The earlier and later suits concern the same loan transaction.
predicates.omitted_relief_available_earlier: The borrower could have sought the relief claimed in the later suit in the earlier suit.
predicates.omitted_relief_deliberately_abandoned: The borrower deliberately chose not to seek that relief in the earlier suit.

issues.definition: When a borrower brings a later relief suit concerning the same transaction after deliberately abandoning relief that was available in an earlier relief suit, the later suit is barred.
